column1: # SandboxID carrier pool — real MCC/MNC network operators for SIM/carrier spoof
# 140 genuine carriers across 67 countries. Every MCC/MNC/ISO here is a REAL
# allocation taken from the public mcc-mnc.com dataset (no fabricated codes);
# only the human-readable name is normalized. The `carrier` command in
# rotate_ids.sh reads one row and writes the operator identity into
# GSM_OPERATOR_ISO = iso, GSM_CARRIER_ID = carrier_id). Add your own by
#   mnc         Mobile Network Code (2-3 digits, width preserved for numeric)
#   carrier_id  OPTIONAL 5th column: Android canonical carrier id, taken verbatim
#               Consumed by the L3 telephony hook. Leave blank when the operator is
#               not in Google's carrier DB — a real device reports -1 (UNKNOWN) there,
#               so blank is the truthful value. Do NOT invent numbers.
